name: @geo-content-os/worker-knowledge
description: GEO Content OS — recoverable knowledge ingestion and embedding worker

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-embedding build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-ocr build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-storage build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-web-fetch build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/parsers build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --pretty false
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-embedding build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-ocr build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-storage build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-web-fetch build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/parsers build && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
